messages:
sam: Alert from Sentry/ingress: sudden 5xx burst in eu-west-2. Deploybot auto-paused the 12:00 release slot. Can we lock this down and outline a short recovery plan?

deploy-bot: [automated] paused slot 2026-03-05T12:00Z due to service.edge 5xx > threshold. Paused window 12:00-12:30. Reason: ingress-proxy queue drops detected.

leah: Confirming emergency hold. My suggestion: pin canary to last-stable (v3.1.4), disable the new runtime opt-in `agg-rescale` on canaries only, and create a staggered tentative slot later (18:00) with 4m cadence.

omar: I can flip `agg-rescale` off on canaries now. It was enabled in yesterday's runtime rollout and correlates with queue backpressure at high RPS. Will patch config and restart canary edge pods.

infra-sre: Applying patch: `kubectl patch cm edge-runtime -n services -p '{"data":{"agg-rescale":"false"}}'` then `kubectl rollout restart ds/edge-runtime`. Rolling restart started; ETA ~8m. Monitoring metrics.

sam: I'll mark the slot DO_NOT_REQUEUE and have releasectl pin to v3.1.4. Also will add a short release-note entry so release schedulers don't accidentally resubmit.

leah: Running pin: `releasectl pin --slot 12:00 --version v3.1.4 --reason "incident hold - ingress 5xx"` ; adding note redact: "paused; pinned to stable; canaries patched".

deploy-bot: tentative slot created: 2026-03-05T18:00Z (stagger 4m). Backfill policy: emergency fixes + doc-only changes. Original slot flagged DO_NOT_REQUEUE.

omar: Canaries restarted. Early signal: 5xx rate down ~50% on canaries in first 3m. Still watching tail latencies and queue drops.

infra-sre: No infra alarms currently. CPU and queue metrics normalizing. We'll hold for 20m watch before recommending clear.

sam: Owners recap: leah = pin & release note; omar = runtime param rollback on canaries; infra-sre = monitor & escalate; sam = calendar update + DO_NOT_REQUEUE. Meeting check-in in 20m here.

leah: Note to teams: please don't requeue 12:00 slot manually; use the tentative 18:00 slot if you have low-risk fixes. I'll update CHANGELOG and the incident ticket.

omar: I'll attach trace links and a short how-to for reverting the config if the 18:00 canary shows regressions.

infra-sre: Leaving alerts on. If 5xx resurges we'll consider rolling back the entire runtime rollout.

sam: Thanks all. Reopen thread with any new blockers.
